mapper.select:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_title, p.product_name, p.product_content, MIN(PO.OPTION_PRICE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PO.OPTION_ID ASC) AS PRICE, NVL(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(R.SCORE), 1) FROM REVIEW R JOIN ORDERDETAIL OD_SUB ON R.OD_ID = OD_SUB.OD_ID JOIN OPTIONDETAIL SUB_OD ON OD_SUB.POP_ID = SUB_OD.POP_ID WHERE SUB_OD.PRODUCT_ID = p.product_id ), 0.0) AS avg_score,
( SELECT COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) FROM REVIEW R JOIN ORDERDETAIL OD_SUB ON R.OD_ID = OD_SUB.OD_ID JOIN OPTIONDETAIL SUB_OD ON OD_SUB.POP_ID = SUB_OD.POP_ID WHERE SUB_OD.PRODUCT_ID = p.product_id ) AS review_count,
( SELECT COUNT(W.WISH_ID) FROM WISH W WHERE W.PRODUCT_ID = p.product_id ) AS wish_count
FROM product p JOIN optiondetail o ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN productoption po ON po.option_id = o.option_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_title, p.product_name, p.product_content
select product_image_save_name as thumbnail from productimage where product_id = #{productId} and product_title_image = 0
select product_image_save_name as images from productimage where product_id = #{productId} and product_title_image = 1
select product_image_save_name as images from productimage where product_id = #{productId} and product_title_image = 2

select o.option_id, o.option_name, o.option_price as price, od.POP_ID, o.OPTION_STOCK as stock from productoption o join optiondetail od on o.option_id = od.option_id join product p on od.product_id = p.product_id where p.product_id = #{productId}
select coupon_id, coupon_name, coupon_text, to_char(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as created_at, to_char(DEADLINE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as deadline from COUPON
select count(*) from COUPONHISTORY where MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} and COUPON_ID = #{couponId}
mapper.insert: insert into COUPONHISTORY (chist_id, member_id, coupon_id, type, created_at) values (SEQ_CHIST_ID.nextval,#{memberId}, #{couponId}, 'ISSUE', sysdate)
mapper.select:
SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.SCORE, r.REVIEW_TEXT, TO_CHAR(r.WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS writeDate, po.OPTION_NAME, p.PRODUCT_NAME, po.OPTION_PRICE, m.NICKNAME, orderd.QTY, r.LIKE_COUNT, CASE WHEN rl.MEMBER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_liked
FROM review r
JOIN orderdetail orderd ON r.OD_ID = orderd.OD_ID
JOIN OPTIONDETAIL od ON orderd.POP_ID = od.POP_ID
JOIN PRODUCTOPTION po ON po.OPTION_ID = od.OPTION_ID JOIN product p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = od.PRODUCT_ID
JOIN member m ON m.MEMBER_ID = r.MEMBER_ID
LEFT JOIN REVIEWLIKE rl ON r.REVIEW_ID = rl.REVIEW_ID AND rl.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
WHERE p.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
select ri.REVIEW_ID, REVIEW_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME as review_images from REVIEWIMAGE ri join REVIEW r on ri.REVIEW_ID = r.REVIEW_ID where r.REVIEW_ID in #{reviewId}
mapper.update: update REVIEW set LIKE_COUNT = LIKE_COUNT+1 where REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
mapper.select:
select like_id from REVIEWLIKE where review_id = #{reviewId}
and MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: update REVIEW set LIKE_COUNT = LIKE_COUNT-1 where REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
mapper.delete:
delete REVIEWLIKE where review_id = #{reviewId}
and MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
